name: European Long distance path E1 - Norway (north)
description_md:
The European Long distance path E1 in Norway is a waymarked hiking route spanning 478.6 km. It is signposted as E1 and is part of the international waymarked hiking network.

This hard route requires about 140 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule, featuring 7774 m of ascent and 7331 m of descent. The difficulty of the path is derived from the distance and ascent. The line matches the official route published by turrutebasen, and the path passes Nordkapp within 300 m.
